name: Gimbal, Gremlin Prodigy
oracle_text:
Artifact creatures you control have trample.
At the beginning of your end step, create a 0/0 red Gremlin artifact creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of differently named artifact tokens you control.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, create a 0/0 red Gremlin artifact creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of differently named artifact tokens you control.

needs.what: a 0/0 red Gremlin artifact creature token (types Artifact, Creature; subtype Gremlin; color R; no abilities), e.g. id gremlin_0_0_r_artifact
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only Gremlin in token_ids is gremlin_1_1_r, a 1/1 red Gremlin creature that is not an artifact; create_token can override power/toughness but not add the Artifact type, and being an artifact matters both for the trample static and for the token counting itself in X. The rest of the line is expressible: end_step trigger, create_token with as-binding, then add_counters whose amount is {"distinct": {"of": "name", "objects": {"controller": "you", "types": ["Artifact"], "is_token": true}}}
